one_question_rule: Only the current question may be answered; early finalization, skipping, or reordering is rejected.
unknown_rule: Unknown binding, evidence, or identity transitions the drill to UNKNOWN_BLOCKED.
incomplete_rule: Incomplete coverage transitions the drill to DRILL_INCOMPLETE and cannot succeed.
universal_closeout_receipt_rule: The general governance closeout receipt contract is mandatory in APPRENTICESHIP mode; archive is invalid until every preceding receipt is present and authoritative.
receipt_rule: Lifecycle receipts must be authoritative host readbacks; synthetic receipts are invalid.
identity_rule: Learner, Workflow Auditor, Orchestrator, sessions, source, goal, and model are independently bound.
